name: BambooHR Café (Thomas2Go) Daily Hot Entrée Station: Baked Salmon or Herb Chicken with Steamed Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon, UT)
whyItWorks: Thomas Cuisine's hot line at BambooHR focuses on scratch-made whole proteins; asking the server for just the plain roasted chicken breast or baked salmon fillet with steamed white rice or roasted potatoes (skipping the composed sauce) gives you a clean 9+/10 workday lunch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: At the Thomas2Go hot entrée counter, ask for the plain grilled/roasted protein (chicken, turkey, or salmon) with steamed rice or mashed/roasted potatoes and cooked carrots—ask to hold any citrus glaze, chimichurri, or spicy crema.
watchOuts: Check the placard at the station for lemon-herb or garlic-cream sauces and ask for an un-sauced piece from the pan
